TABLE.NAME: qbank_bulkedit_job
TABLE.COMMENT: A bulk edit job: the selected questions, the field and the rule to apply

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context of the question bank the job runs in

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module of the question bank

FIELD.NAME: returnurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Local URL of the question bank page to return to

FIELD.NAME: qtypes
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma separated list of question types to include

FIELD.NAME: field
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the field to edit

FIELD.NAME: aiinstruction
FIELD.COMMENT: Plain language instruction given to the AI rule builder

FIELD.NAME: airule
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON encoded rule as last returned by the AI

FIELD.NAME: aibackend
FIELD.COMMENT: AI backend used to build the rule

FIELD.NAME: aimodel
FIELD.COMMENT: AI model used to build the rule

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft, previewed, applying, done or failed

TABLE.NAME: qbank_bulkedit_item
TABLE.COMMENT: One selected question within a bulk edit job

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question version that was selected and previewed

FIELD.NAME: newquestionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question version created when the rule was applied

FIELD.NAME: included
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the user wants the change applied

FIELD.NAME: oldhash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the field value when previewed
